title: Coconut Flour Loaf
blurb: A light, grain-free loaf made with coconut flour and eggs. Slice and toast for breakfast or serve alongside soup.
steps: Heat your oven to 180°C and grease a 900g loaf tin with a little butter.
Beat the softened butter and xylitol together in a large bowl until smooth and creamy.
Add the eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition until fully combined.
Sift in the coconut flour, baking powder and salt, then fold gently until you have a thick, smooth batter.
Pour the batter into the prepared tin and smooth the top with a spatula.
Bake for 35 to 40 minutes until golden on top and a skewer inserted into the centre comes out clean.
Leave to cool in the tin for 10 minutes, then turn out onto a wire rack to cool completely before slicing.
